title: Shared workspace shell
responsibility: Assembles workspace navigation, the catalog or entity view, project-agent controls and status.

inputs.name: WorkspaceShell.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace state (a WorkspaceState instance) whose error, entity and projectId decide what renders and under which keys, and which the shell passes unchanged to NavBar, EntityView, CatalogView, StatusBar and ProjectAgent. It is required, and the shell itself never assigns to it.

inputs.name: WorkspaceShell.account
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet of host-account content that the shell passes unchanged to NavBar as its account prop and never renders itself. When omitted it is undefined, so NavBar receives undefined for account.

outputs.name: WorkspaceShell
outputs.description: Markup rooted at an hx-div with class workspace, holding NavBar, an hx-p with class error and role alert that shows the text of workspace.error when it is truthy, EntityView when workspace.entity is truthy or otherwise CatalogView, then StatusBar and ProjectAgent. EntityView is keyed by projectId and entity id, CatalogView and ProjectAgent by projectId alone, so a project change recreates the shown view and ProjectAgent, while a change of entity id alone recreates only EntityView.
